questions.question: Rajasthan, famous for its forts, palaces, and desert landscapes, has branded itself as the “Land of Kings.” The Rajasthan Tourism Department has been actively using digital storytelling to attract domestic and international tourists by highlighting its unique heritage and royal culture. questions.question: Ramaraj Mundukal, a trusted name in traditional men’s wear (especially dhotis/mundus), has been serving South Indian customers for decades. Traditionally, sales relied on word-of-mouth, retail stores, and festival shopping seasons. Festive campaigns: Onam, Pongal, Vishu, and weddings promoted through reels, short videos, and celebrity endorsements. E-commerce & digital ads: Products sold online via their website, Flipkart, and Amazon; boosted with targeted Google/Instagram ads. Engaging younger audiences: Modern styled mundus, combo packs, and styling reels showing how traditional attire can blend with contemporary fashion. Through these efforts, Ramaraj Mundukal successfully repositioned a traditional attire into a stylish, youthful, and culturally significant product, competing strongly against both local weavers and global clothing brands.
